rows.title: Eyelid or eyeball?
rows.desc: A lid flutter is not the same as eyes that move

rows.title: What sets it off?
rows.desc: Head turns, bending, rolling over in bed

rows.title: Any hearing change?
rows.desc: New ringing, fullness or muffled hearing

rows.title: Any red flags?
rows.desc: Trouble seeing, speaking or walking: call 911
